The plate looks like a small paper plate, about 18-20 cm across (roughly 260 px in the image). It holds sliced sausage, probably smoked sausage or kielbasa, in about 12 pieces.

Most slices are about 4 cm across, roughly 65 px at this scale. Each is about 1.5 cm thick, so one slice is about π × 2² × 1.5 ≈ 19 cm³, or about 19 g. A few slices look thicker or are stacked, so I put the total at about 12 slices × 17 g ≈ 200 g. Allowing for some smaller pieces, I settled on 180 g.

Smoked sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g.
